articles.summary: The FIFA World Cup 2026™ hosted in the USA, Canada, and Mexico, concluded this July with Spain lifting football's most coveted prize. As celebrations swept across the country, Coca-Cola extended the excitement with a limited-edition, giving consumers the chance to relive the moment through eye-catching golden cans inspired by the iconic trophy itself.
articles.title: Crown brings Coca-Cola’s golden cans to life in record time to celebrate the champions of FIFA World Cup 2026™
